title: Basic beginners program
author: Jack  L.
desc:
I designed this program for people wanting to dip there toe into lifting with as little time possible , with good effort and technique only one to two sets are
 needed , especially for a first time lifter

ex.note:
Shoulders back and down 
Full stretch each rep 
Pull as far down as possible until too difficult 
End set when can't pull to eye line

Keep chest proud entire time
Pull shoulders back and down 
Wiggle before first rep to set hips and upper back 
Don't lock out elbows think 90% of the way up

Breathe into belly 
Don't lock knees, very slight to slight knee bend 
Chest high entire time 
Lower very slow keep the stretch in hams

Use plates for foot elevation 
Keep chest high 
Don't lean any direction, think leaning very slightly backwards 
Push knee over toe while keeping whole foot flush with floor 
Use back foot for balance

Slow into full stretch each rep 
No need to lock out 
Find if you want elbows flared or tucked into head try both 
Can use numerous attachments try rope first

Use high incline bench almost 90 degrees 
Set hips and upper back into bench like the dB press 
Come up as high as possible for as long as possible you will naturally decrease range as you fatigue

Standing or seated is fine 
Squeeze glutes and core 
Raise slightly out Infront not directly to sides
Hold dB on the inside 
Elbows lead 
Pour water out of jug
